description: CISA ICS advisories by vendor or sector from CISA's full CSAF history (since 2010), newest first. CVSS from the advisory, missing scores from NVD. Returns advisory IDs, CVE scores, vendors, CISA sectors, OT severity and triage links. One of vendor or sector is required. Price: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

model.description: Your device model (e.g. s7-1500): advisories naming it first, and asset_match per advisory

sector.description: Sector filter e.g. energy, water, manufacturing

since.description: Only advisories first published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
